heading: Purposes
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text: The purposes of this Act are—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to clarify, simplify and consolidate the laws
relating to criminal procedure in the
Magistrates' Court, the County Court and the
Supreme Court;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to provide new pre-trial disclosure
requirements for the prosecution;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to provide for the transfer to the County
Court or Supreme Court of summary
offences related to an offence to be tried on
indictment by the relevant court;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to abolish the procedure of indictment by
grand jury;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to clarify the tests relating to determination
of appeals by the Court of Appeal;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to provide for the stay of sentences on
appeal;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "j", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to amend the Sentencing Act 1991 to
provide for a maximum fine that may be
imposed for an indictable offence that is
heard and determined summarily;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "k", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}
text:
to amend the Crimes Act 1958, the Crimes
(Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be
Tried) Act 1997, the Magistrates' Court
Act 1989, the Children, Youth and
Families Act 2005 and the Appeal Costs
Act 1998;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "l", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "clause": "1"}

to repeal the Crimes (Criminal Trials) Act
1999;
